description: The plot illustrates the training loss curves for different methods with respect to the number of steps. The x-axis is labeled "#Iteration" with a linear scale, ranging from 0 to 15000000 in intervals of 5000000. The y-axis is labeled "Loss" with a linear scale, ranging from 3.0 to 3.4 in intervals of 0.1. The plot contains four lines: a blue solid line representing "Vanilla" that starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 3.1; a red dashed line representing "StrmLLM (n=64)" that begins at about 3.3 and drops to roughly 3.15; a green dashed line representing "SepLLM (n=64)" that starts at approximately 3.3 and decreases to around 3.13; and a purple dashed line representing "SepLLM (n=128)" that begins at about 3.3 and drops to roughly 3.13, with another two lines "SepLLM (n=64, H)" and "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" that are also dashed and colored orange and black respectively, both starting at around 3.3 and decreasing to approximately 3.12 and 3.11. All lines exhibit a downward trend across the x-axis, with the most significant decrease occurring between 0 and 5000000 steps.
